test_grpc_beta_python_plugin: test the gRPC beta Python protoc plugin by running all 18 test cases in PythonPluginTest
run_ServicerMethods_UnaryCall: run the UnaryCall servicer method to return a compressable payload response with a given size
run_ServicerMethods_FullDuplexCall: run the FullDuplexCall servicer method to stream responses for each request in a full-duplex RPC
run_ServicerMethods_HalfDuplexCall: run the HalfDuplexCall servicer method to buffer all requests then yield responses in a half-duplex RPC
run_CreateService_context_manager: run the _CreateService context manager to spin up a gRPC server and stub for testing RPC calls
